[u]Computation of the excess of $\sqrt{10}$ over 1.[/u] The numerator, $S_n$ and the denominator,
$S_{n-1}$, of the $(n-10)^{\underline{th}}$ approximation are computed by the formula,
$S_n = \frac{1}{9} (S_{n-1} + 10 S_{n-2} + 10 S_{n-3} + 5 S_{n-4} + S_{n-5})$. The first five $S$'s are taken arbitrarily.

$S_1 = S_2 = S_3 = S_4 = 0$
$9 S_5 = S_5 = 1$
[u]$S_6 = 1$[/u]
$9 S_6 = 10.555555555555555555555555555556 = S_6$
$S_7 = 1.172839506172839506172839506173 = S_7$
$5 S_7 = 5.864197530864197530864197530864$
$10 (S_6 + S_5) = 11.111111111111111111111111111111$
$9 S_7 = 16.975308641975308641975308641975$
[u]$S_8 = 1.886145404663923182441700960219$[/u] $= S_8$
$5 (S_8 + S_5) = 14.430727023319615912208504801097$
$10 (S_7 + S_6) = 12.839506172839506172839506172839$
$9 S_8 = 27.270233196159122085048010973937$
[u]$S_9 = 3.030025910684346898338667885993$[/u] $= S_9$
$5 (S_9 + S_6) = 16.705685108977290047248894985520$
[del]$10 S_7 = 18.86145404663923182441700960219$[/del]
$10 S_8 = 18.861454046639231824417009602190$
$10 S_7 = 11.728395061728395061728395061728$
$9 S_9 = 47.295534217344916933394299649438$
[u]$S_{10} = 5.255059357482766325932699961049$[/u] $= S_{10}$
$5 S_{10} = 26.275296787413831629663499805245$
$10 (S_9 + S_5) = 49.161713153482700807803688462120$
$S_8 + S_7 = 5.975308641975308641975308641975$
$9 S_{10} = 81.412312582872841079442496909340$
[u]$S_{11} = 9.045813175874760119938055212149$[/u] $= S_{11}$
$5 S_{11} = 45.229065879373800599690276060745$
$10 (S_{10} + S_6) = 82.850852681671132242713678470420$
$5 S_9 = 9.430727023376543209876543209877$
$S_7 = 1.172839506172839506172839506173$
$9 S_{11} = 138.683485090594315558453337247215$
[u]$S_{12} = 15.409276121177146173161481916357$[/u] $= S_{12}$
$5 S_{12} = 77.046380605885730865807409581785$

$5 S_9 = 15.150129553421734491693339427765$
